entries.058efc6e4b98f4f7: An open platform service for system development companies and freelancers, operated by WhiteBox Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary of the company. Basic functions such as registering and managing the development history (skill sheets) of affiliated engineers or the freelancers themselves are free to use, while functions for 1st-tier contractors to post and propose projects in order to recruit partners and to share information about partners and engineers incur a monthly basic fee. As of the end of December 2025, 3,188 companies were registered as members, and the skill sheets of over 30,000 engineers were registered.
entries.0a73a820fc6b225a: In the information services industry to which the group belongs, net sales of custom software in fiscal 2024 were ¥11,042.9 billion (up 7.8% year on year), and the domestic IT services market is forecast to grow to ¥7,566.3 billion in 2025 and ¥10,254.1 billion in 2030. The group has large corporate groups with annual sales of ¥100 billion or more as its main customers, and its customer retention rate is about 95%. As of the end of December 2025, 3,188 companies were registered as members of "WhiteBox," and the skill sheets of more than 30,000 engineers were registered.

entries.6792c620cdb1976f: Under its corporate philosophy of "eliminating everything," it eliminates issues such as the multi-layer subcontracting structure in system development and promotes "0th-order DX," working together with customers. It states that 0th-order system development has the advantage of being able to provide agile development at prices more competitive than those of major 1st-tier prime contractors, by receiving orders directly from customers and not using multi-layer subcontracting. It states that, leveraging the customer network it has built, as a "general trading company for DX" it aims for growth by strengthening solution services such as the 0th-order Lab, strengthening advanced technologies such as AI and cybersecurity, and using investments and M&A.
